intent: Individually distinguish general fruit, slicing without peeling, ripe enough versus cooked/eaten, capacity versus actual packing, peel position, squeezed lemon juice, a single grape entering a bag and smell versus taste.
picturePurpose: Manipulate skin and preparation, illustrative container fit and single-object fall destination. Exact geometry and labels remain coded; no actual dimensions or completion inferred.

workshop.title: 水果句子：保留皮、放得下、掉进哪里
workshop.instruction: 调果皮和形态，比较饭盒大小，再看单粒葡萄的终点。

items.label: 水果（本句）
items.prompt: fruit只指苹果吗？圈出种类范围和零食用途。
items.reason: Fresh fruit makes a simple snack说新鲜水果是一种简便的零食。
items.hint: 本句fruit泛指水果，不限定某一种，也没有报告谁已经吃了。
items.material: Fresh fruit makes a simple snack.

items.material: Slice the apple without removing the skin.

wordDecision.prompt: 切成片时皮留不留？分别调形态和果皮，保留without。

wordDecision.prompt: ripe enough to eat说成熟程度，还是已经吃掉？

transfer.stem: 换成黄瓜、小梨和樱桃，哪组三句完整保留条件？
transfer.passage:
新的野餐准备
黄瓜不去皮，切成片。一个小梨正好能放在野餐盒里。一颗樱桃从枝上掉进了我的篮子。

options.text: Slice the cucumber after removing the skin. A small pear fits neatly in the picnic box. One cherry fell from the branch into my basket.
Slice the cucumber without removing the skin. A small pear fits neatly in the picnic box. One cherry fell from the branch into my basket.
Slice the cucumber without removing the skin. A small pear is too large to fit in the picnic box. One cherry fell from the branch into my basket.
Slice the cucumber without removing the skin. A small pear fits neatly in the picnic box. One cherry fell from the branch and landed beside my basket.

answer.display: Slice the cucumber without removing the skin. A small pear fits neatly in the picnic box. One cherry fell from the branch into my basket.

explanation.strategy: 逐项核对without的否定条件、fits的容纳关系和into的终点。

steps.text: Slice…without removing the skin保留切片但不去皮。
steps.reason: 换成黄瓜以后，without的否定条件仍不能变。

steps.text: fits neatly in保留小梨正好能放在盒子里。
steps.reason: fits表示放得下，不能改成too large。

steps.text: One cherry…into my basket保留一颗樱桃进入篮子。
steps.reason: into是进入，beside是旁边；两者落点不同。

distractors.reason: after removing the skin把不去皮改成去皮后。
too large to fit把能放得下改成放不下。
beside把掉进篮子改成落在篮子旁。

explanation.pitfall: 认出食物名称还不够，否定、容纳关系和终点都要保留。
